arabic text: HASHR MEIN RANG LAYEGA KHUNE SHAHIDA DEKHNA\nAYENGI JAB FATEMA HAAL-E- PARESHAN DEKHNA
english translation text: THE VALUE OF THE BLOOD OF THE MARTYRS WILL BE SHOWN ON DAY OF JUDGEMENT\nYOU WILL SEE THE STATE OF SADNESS WHEN BIBI FATEMA (A.S) WILL COME

arabic text:
ROO BARU BABA KAY JAB KHATOON JANNAT E AYENGEE
KHALI JOLI SARWAR-E- KONAIN KO DEKHLAI GEE
BIL YAKEEN THARRAYEGA
MEHSHAR KA MAIDAN DEKHNA
english translation text: WHEN THE LADY OF PARADISE WILL BE FACE-TO-FACE WITH HER FATHER\nSHE WILL HER SHOW EMPTY LAP TO HER FATHER (SAW)\nFOR SURE, THE PLAINS OF JUDGEMENT DAY WILL TREMBLE, YOU SHALL SEE

arabic text:
RAKHDIYA BARCHI NE AKBER KA KALEJA CHEER KE,
RUKH BADAL DALE HAI UMMAT NE TERI TASWEER KE,
MALIKE KAWSAR ZARAA
UMMAT KE EHSAN DEKHNA
english translation text:
THE SPEAR LEFT AKBAR'S LIVER IN A PIERCED STATE
THE MUSLIM NATION HAS DISFIGURED YOUR RESEMBLANCE
O MASTER OF THE FOUNTAIN OF KAUSAR
WITNESS, HOW THE UMMAH HAS REPAID US

arabic text:
ASGARE MASOOM KE LAB PAR SAWAALE AAB HAI,
BOOND PAANI KE LIYE WO KIS KADAR BETAB HAI,
NEHR SE PAANI NAHI
DEYTAY MUSALMAN DEKHNA
english translation text: ON THE LIPS OF THE INNOCENT ASGAR IS A REQUEST FOR WATER\nHOW RESTLESS IS HE FOR A DROP OF WATER\nTHE MUSLIMS DO NOT GIVE WATER FROM THE RIVER, YOU SHALL WITNESS

arabic text:
ZAINAB O KULSOOM SAY KEHTA THA SHIMR E BAD GOHAR
SHAAM MEIN JAWONGE NANGE SAR PHIRONGI DAR BADAR,
KARBELA KE BAAD AB
TAREEK ZINDAAN DEKHNA
english translation text:
SHIMR THE WRETCHED USED TO SAY TO ZAINAB AND KULSOOM
YOU WILL BE PARADED THROUGH THE STREETS OF DAMASCUS, UNVEILED FROM PLACE TO PLACE
AFTER KARBALA, NOW
YOU SHALL WITNESS THE DARK PRISON

english translation text: SAKINA WAS CRYING OUT FOR HER UNCLE AND SAID: 'SHIMR IS BEATING ME, COME AND SAVE ME UNCLE'. LOOK HOW ABBAS’ BODY TREMBLED ON THE BANK OF THE RIVER

arabic text:
GHAM BHALAA GULZAAR KA IS DIL KO ROZE HASHAR KA
JO HAI AWLAADE PAYAMBER KI MUHABBAT SE BHARAA,
YASRAB KE SULTAN DEKHNA
BAKSHWA DENGE USE
english translation text: WHY SHOULD THIS HEART OF GULZAR FEAR THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT? IT IS FILLED WITH LOVE FOR THE CHILDREN OF THE PROPHET. THE SULTAN OF YATHRIB WILL SECURE FORGIVENESS FOR HIM, YOU SHALL SEE.
